headline: ElevenLabs reportedly targets $33 billion valuation for a funding round in 2027
body: ElevenLabs plans to launch a funding round in the first three months of 2027 at a target valuation of $33 billion, Bloomberg reported, citing unnamed sources. That figure would be up from the $22 billion valuation it achieved in September after an employee tender offer. ElevenLabs declined to comment on the claims, per the report.
note: The $33 billion target would be up from the $22 billion valuation from September, and ElevenLabs may start preparing for an initial public offering in 2027, according to the report.

evidence.text: ElevenLabs , a builder of artificial intelligence (AI) voice models and agents, plans to launch a funding round process in the first three months of 2027 at a target valuation of $33 billion, Bloomberg reported Wednesday (Nov. 25), citing unnamed sources.
That figure would be up from the $22 billion valuation ElevenLabs achieved in September after an employee tender offer, according to the report.
ElevenLabs declined Bloomberg’s invitation to comment on the claims, per the report.
CEO Mati Staniszewski has said that ElevenLabs may start preparing for an initial public offering in 2027, according to the report.
